create_ManagedAttribute_with_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor that enforces a specific type when setting an attribute on a Runner or Reducer class
create_ManagedAttribute_without_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor with no type enforcement to manage flexible attribute access on a class
review_ManagedAttribute_set_name: review the ManagedAttribute __set_name__ method that stores public and private attribute names with underscore prefix
review_ManagedAttribute_get: review the ManagedAttribute __get__ descriptor method that retrieves the private attribute value from the owner object
test_ManagedAttribute_set: test the ManagedAttribute __set__ method to verify type enforcement raises ValueError on invalid assignments
